site_description: NAV history, returns, and fund size for every Indonesian mutual fund (reksa dana), from Bibit, Bareksa, Kontan, and Makmur. Free to download.
freshness_hint: The newest NAV date in the data
footer_disclaimer: Not affiliated with any of these sources. Not financial advice: check a fund's prospectus before you invest. Buy links include the site owner's referral codes.
not_found_text: This page does not exist, or it has moved. Search for a fund, or open one of these pages.
home_title: Every Indonesian mutual fund, in one table
home_lede: Price, returns, size, and costs from Bibit, Bareksa, Kontan, Makmur, and OJK.
type_other_note: Private placements, real estate, and gold ETFs
type_median_title: Median 1-year return of {count} funds with one
filter_inactive_title: {count} funds with no NAV in the last month: most are closed or merged
col_ytd_title: Return since the end of last year
col_aum_title: Assets under management, in the fund currency
empty_hint_inactive: Try fewer words or filters, or include inactive funds.
tag_inactive_title: No NAV in the last month
tag_dividend_title: Pays cash dividends. Unless "Include dividends" is ticked, returns here count the NAV only, so its total return is higher.
tag_zero_aum_title: OJK reports zero assets for this fund in its newest month: it may be dissolved, matured, or not launched yet
flag_large_move: The NAV moved more than 20% in one day in the last year. See the fund page.
method_nav: NAV is the price of one unit, in the fund's currency, on the date below it.
method_returns: Returns are, by default, the change in NAV over the period, not annualised, computed from the daily NAV history. Funds tagged Dividend also pay cash out, so their total return is higher than the NAV change; tick Include dividends to reinvest the payouts the data knows about and show their total return instead.
method_median: Median 1Y in each type is the middle 1-year return of the funds that match your other filters.
method_aum: Fund size (AUM) is the latest monthly figure. US$ marks a fund that reports in dollars; sorting converts it to rupiah.
method_inactive: Inactive funds have no NAV in the last month. Most are closed, merged, or no longer reported, so they are hidden by default.
method_flag: ! marks a fund whose NAV moved more than 20% in one day in the last year: a real event or a data error. The fund page shows when.
type_desc_money: Low risk, for money you need soon
type_desc_bond: Moderate risk, for goals 1 to 3 years away
type_desc_equity: Higher risk, for goals over 5 years away
type_desc_mixed: A mix of stocks and bonds, for 3 to 5 years
type_desc_global: Invests abroad, so exchange rates count too
type_desc_protected: Protected at maturity, money is locked in
csv_title: Download the funds in this list as a CSV file
filters_note: A fund without a figure is left out while you set a limit on it.
col_cagr_3y_title: Average return per year over 3 years (CAGR)
col_cagr_5y_title: Average return per year over 5 years (CAGR)
col_fall_title: Biggest drop in NAV from a peak, last {period}
col_expense_title: What the fund charges each year, as a share of its assets. The source is under the figure.
col_operating_expense_title: The fund's operating expenses over the calendar year shown under the figure, as a share of its average assets. From the audited figures in its prospectus. It includes transaction costs, so it is usually higher than the fee caps.
col_min_purchase_title: Lowest first purchase among the sellers, in rupiah
col_fee_title: Highest fee the prospectus allows (Bareksa data)
method_fall: Max fall is the biggest drop in NAV from a peak to a later low within the period. 5% means the fund once stood 5% below its high.
method_costs: 3Y/yr is the average return per year (CAGR). Expense ratio and minimum purchase come from the sources that state them, named under the figure; a blank means no source states it. Buy and sell fees are the highest the prospectus allows.
fund_description: NAV history, returns, fund size, and documents for {name}, a reksa dana managed by {manager}.
fund_description_no_manager: NAV history, returns, fund size, and documents for {name}, a reksa dana managed by an Indonesian investment manager.
inactive_frozen: The NAV has not changed since {date}, although some sources still list it.
inactive_reason: The fund may be closed, merged, or no longer reported.
moves_title_one: Large one-day move in the NAV:
moves_title_many: Large one-day moves in the NAV:
moves_note_one: Returns that span it include the move. It can be a real event, such as a default, or an error in the source data.
moves_note_many: Returns that span them include the move. It can be a real event, such as a default, or an error in the source data.
chart_nav_only: NAV only: this fund also pays dividends. Tick "Include dividends" to count them.
chart_load_failed: The charts failed to load. Reload the page.
returns_row_worst_fall_title: Largest fall from a peak within the period
returns_note: Change in NAV, computed from the {source} history.
returns_note_dividends: This fund pays dividends, which these figures leave out, so its total return is higher. Tick "Include dividends" to count them.
returns_note_per_year: "Per year" is shown for periods of a year or more.
buy_note: New users type the code in the app. It helps keep this site running.
data_spike_one: 1 one-day spike that reversed the next day is left out as a source error.
data_spikes_many: {count} one-day spikes that reversed the next day are left out as source errors.
source_bareksa: daily NAV, monthly AUM, units, asset mix
api_description: A free, read-only JSON and CSV API for Indonesian mutual fund data. No key, open CORS.
api_lede: Free, read-only, static JSON and CSV files. No key, open CORS, rebuilt whenever the data changes.
api_quickstart_text: No key is needed, and Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * lets you call this from a browser. Every path below is a GET request. An unknown path answers 404.
api_endpoints_text: Replace RD216 with any id from {listLink}. An old ID of a fund that was merged into another redirects (301) to the new one.
api_purpose_zip: One source's data, or one part of it.
api_conv_numbers_text: Returns and ratios are fractions: 0.0106 is 1.06%. Numbers use a decimal point.
api_conv_currency_text: AUM and NAV are in the fund's own currency. It is null when no source states it.
api_conv_missing_text: A missing part is null, or an empty list.
api_funds_text: An index of every fund, one per real fund: the records of Bibit, Bareksa, Kontan, and Makmur that belong to one fund are joined into it. The columns of {csvLink}, typed, plus the latest NAV and fund size.
api_funds_id: The fund ID, e.g. RD1983. A Bibit symbol, or BRK, KTN or MKR plus a source ID for a fund Bibit does not list.
api_funds_name: The current name of the fund.
api_funds_other_names: Other names the sources use for it, for example before a rename.
api_funds_type: Indonesian fund type, in Bibit's labels, e.g. Obligasi. Null for index funds, ETFs and DPLK.
api_funds_currency: IDR or USD. Null when no source says.
api_funds_sharia: Sharia-compliant fund. Null when no source says.
api_funds_launch_date: First NAV date known to any source.
api_funds_sources: The IDs of the fund in each source: \{ bibit, bareksa, kontan, makmur \}, each a list, the best record first.
api_funds_active: The latest NAV is within a month of the newest data of its source.
api_funds_aum: Latest fund size, in the fund currency.
api_funds_aum_date: Date of the latest fund size.
api_funds_return_1y: Change in NAV over 1 year, as a fraction, computed from the NAV history.
api_fund_text: Everything about one fund: the full Bibit record (when Bibit lists it), plus fund, history, documents, switchables, dividends, nav, aum, and the matching funds from Kontan, Bareksa, and Makmur. A missing part is null, or an empty list for nav and aum.
api_fund_fund: The fund as in the fund list above, with all its source IDs.
api_fund_history: The NAV and fund size the site draws: \{ nav, aum \}, each a list of \{ date, value, source \}. The CSV files are made from it. dividend_events lists the dividends behind the Include dividends returns, each \{ date, factor \}: the ex-date and how much a unit grows when the payout is reinvested.
api_fund_costs: Costs and minimums, each value with its source (bibit, makmur, bareksa, or prospectus): operating_expense \{ value, year, url, uploaded, provider, source \}, the operating expenses of the newest calendar year in the fund's prospectus, as a fraction (0.0203 is 2.03%), with the prospectus file, its upload month (Bareksa's copy only) and its provider: manager for the file on the manager's website, bareksa for Bareksa's copy. The newer year wins, and for the same year the manager's file. It is audited, one value per year, and includes transaction costs, so it is usually above the fee caps. It is null when the prospectus is missing, scanned, has share classes we cannot tell apart, or has tables that disagree. expense_ratio \{ value, source \} as a fraction (the first choice, Bibit before Makmur) and expense_ratios, a list of them with every source's figure, min_purchase a list of \{ amount, currency, source \} per distributor, min_topup and min_redemption \{ amount, currency, source \}, max_fees \{ subscription, redemption, switch \} each \{ min, max, source \} as fractions (a null min means only an upper limit, a max of 0 means free; the figures from Bareksa are the maximum per prospectus), and custodian \{ name, source \}. Each amount has its own currency (null when unknown). A value not in our sources is null or an empty list, never 0.
api_fund_symbol: Bibit ticker. Missing for a fund Bibit does not list, like every other Bibit field.
api_fund_tradeable: You can buy it in the Bibit app.
api_fund_nav: Daily Bibit NAV: \{ date, nav, nav_adjusted \}. Joins the records of a fund that Bibit lists under more than one symbol.
api_fund_aum: Bibit fund size over time: \{ date, aum \}.
api_fund_documents: Links to factsheets and prospectus files.
api_fund_switchables: Funds you can switch to in the app.
api_fund_kontan: The matching Kontan fund, see below.
api_fund_bareksa: The matching Bareksa fund, see below.
api_fund_makmur: The matching Makmur fund, see below.
api_fund_more: Plus every other field Bibit returns: fees, asset allocation, returns, drawdown, and more.
api_kontan_text: kontan holds the Kontan fund id, its name, and its daily NAV. Kontan serves the last 12 months, and every update adds the new days.
api_bareksa_text: bareksa holds the Bareksa fund id and name, then four lists. nav is the daily NAV, refreshed daily for the last year; older days come from the owner's logged-in backfill described in the README. aum is the monthly fund size in rupiah and US dollars, and units the monthly units outstanding. allocation is the monthly asset allocation in percent: saham (equity), obligasi (bonds), pasar_uang (money market), and lainnya (other). Any list can be empty.
api_makmur_text: makmur holds the Makmur fund id, its name, its page address (url), and data, the fund record from Makmur as it is. Makmur scales its numbers: returns, drawdown, CAGR, the expense ratio, and the asset allocation weights are in hundredths of a percent (2162 is 21.62%), and lastPrice is the NAV times 100 (156 is 1.56). lastAum and the minimum buy are plain amounts. Dates are numbers like 20260930.
api_types_text: Fund type codes and their Indonesian labels, as used in the Bibit app's filter.
api_csv_funds_text: The fund list as CSV, an exact copy of data/funds.csv: one row per fund. other_names are separated by |, and each source column holds the source's IDs for the fund, separated by spaces, the best record first. currency and sharia are empty when no source says.
api_csv_nav_text: The NAV history the fund page draws, one row per date. source says where each row came from: bibit, bareksa, kontan, or bareksa-monthly (monthly AUM divided by units, for funds with nothing better). A Worker builds it on request from the fund's JSON, so the files do not count against the deployment's file limit. Before this change it was a copy of the Bibit file with nav_adjusted; the raw source files are in the {downloadLink}. Unknown IDs and funds without a NAV history answer 404, and only GET and HEAD are allowed.
api_csv_aum_text: The fund size history the fund page draws, from the same Worker. source is bibit or bareksa.
api_zip_text: One source's data as a zip file: bibit.zip, kontan.zip, makmur.zip, or bareksa.zip (without the daily NAV). Bareksa's daily NAV is split further, into bareksa-nav-1.zip and up, because a single file here cannot be bigger than 25 MiB. See the full list, with sizes, on the {downloadPageLink}.
download_description: Free CSV and JSON downloads of Indonesian mutual fund data, updated daily.
download_lede: All the data on this site is free to download, as CSV and JSON files, updated daily.
download_funds_csv_note: One row per fund, about 4,500 rows. The records of all sources are joined into one fund each, with the IDs each source uses. For a single field or a single fund, use the {apiLink} instead.
download_zip_text: Each source is also a zip file, because a single file here cannot be bigger than 25 MiB. Bareksa's daily NAV is split further, into several parts of similar size. Every zip keeps the paths of the data/ folder.
download_zip_bareksa: data/bareksa/ without the daily NAV: fund list, AUM, units, asset allocation, and prospectus operating expenses
download_rhythm_bareksa: daily NAV for the last year updated every day; AUM, units, and asset mix monthly; prospectus operating expenses weekly
download_bibit_funds: One row per fund: symbol, name, type, investment manager, currency, latest NAV and AUM.
download_bibit_fund_json: The full Bibit record: fees, manager, custodian bank, asset allocation, top holdings, returns, drawdown, risk profile.
download_bibit_nav: Daily NAV per unit. nav_adjusted is Bibit's dividend-adjusted NAV; its base can change between updates, so compare it only within one download.
download_bibit_dividends: The latest payouts, only for funds that pay dividends. Bibit keeps up to five.
download_bibit_documents: Links to monthly factsheets and prospectus files (PDF or JPG).
download_bibit_switchables: Funds you can switch to in the app, only for funds you can buy there.
download_kontan_funds: One row per Kontan fund: ID, name, manager, category, latest NAV, and bibit_symbol, empty when there is no confident match.
download_kontan_nav: Daily NAV per unit. Kontan keeps the last 12 months, and each run adds the new days.
download_bareksa_funds: One row per fund: Bareksa ID, name, slug, type, manager, launch date, and bibit_symbol, empty when there is no confident match.
download_managers_prospectus: One row per fund: the audited operating expenses (in percent) in the prospectus on its manager's website, with the year, the address of the file, and the version the server gave it. status says why a fund has no value, as in data/bareksa/prospectus.csv; link is the page to open when the file is not a PDF at its address.
download_bareksa_prospectus: One row per fund: the address of its prospectus on Bareksa, the month it was uploaded, and the operating expenses (in percent) of the newest year in its prospectus, with that year. status says why a fund has no value: not_found, scanned, share_classes, partial_year, no_row, conflict, unreadable, or error.
download_bareksa_aum: Monthly assets under management, in rupiah and US dollars.
download_bareksa_allocation: Monthly asset allocation in percent: saham (equity), obligasi (bonds), pasar_uang (money market), lainnya (other).
download_bareksa_nav: Daily NAV per unit. The last year is refreshed every day; older days come from a backfill the owner runs with a logged-in browser (see the project's README).
download_makmur_funds: One row per fund: Makmur ID, name, manager, category, route, web address, currency, latest price, and bibit_symbol.
download_makmur_fund_json: The fund record from its Makmur page, as it is: returns, drawdown, allocation, top holdings, fees, minimum buy, factsheet and prospectus links.
download_note_history: NAV history. Funds you can buy on Bibit have the full daily history from launch. Other funds' Bibit history starts on 2026-10-01, the day this site began collecting it. Kontan adds the last 12 months, and that window grows with every run. Bareksa has daily NAV from launch, once the owner has run the backfill.
download_note_units: Units. Returns are fractions, so 0.0106 means 1.06%. Dates are ISO, YYYY-MM-DD. AUM is in the fund's own currency.
download_note_makmur: Makmur numbers are scaled. Returns, drawdown, CAGR, and the expense ratio are in hundredths of a percent, so 481 means 4.81%. The latest price is the NAV times 100. Dates look like 20260930 for 2026-09-30.
compare_description: Compare the NAV growth, returns, and costs of 2 to 5 Indonesian mutual funds side by side.
compare_lede: Pick 2 to 5 funds to see their growth side by side, then compare their profile, returns, and costs. There is no "best" ranking: funds of different types and risk are not simply comparable.
compare_full: At most {count} funds. Remove one to add another.
compare_empty: Add at least two funds to see the comparison. You can also tick funds in the {link}.
compare_dropped: Not recognised or over the limit, so skipped: {ids}.
compare_picker_failed: The fund list failed to load. Reload the page.
fund_list_failed: The fund list failed to load. Reload the page.
compare_excluded_stale: {name}: its last NAV is {date}, over a month before the other funds, so it is left out of the chart and the returns.
compare_excluded_no_history: {name}: its NAV history is too short, so it is left out of the chart and the returns.
compare_excluded_gap: {name}: it has no NAV near {date}, so it is left out of the chart and the returns.
compare_chart_caption: NAV change in each fund's own currency, dividends not included.
compare_range_unavailable: A fund has no NAV at the start of this period.
compare_chart_none: These funds share no period that can be drawn.
compare_chart_few: The chart needs at least two funds with a recent enough NAV.
compare_returns_note: All figures run to {date}, the last NAV the funds in the chart have in common.
cost_fees_note: Fees are the maximum per prospectus; the fee you pay can be lower.
cost_operating_expense_info: The fund's total operating costs over one calendar year, divided by its average net asset value, as printed in the "Ikhtisar Keuangan Singkat" (brief financial summary) table of its prospectus. The figure is audited, so there is one value per year, and the prospectus is updated once a year, by March to May. It includes transaction costs, such as brokerage, and sometimes tax, so it is usually higher than the fee caps. It is not the same as the expense ratio that Bibit or Makmur show, and the year tells you how old it is.
dividends_toggle_help: Dividends are reinvested on the ex-date. Known only for funds whose payouts the data has ({count} funds); other funds show the NAV change only.
returns_note_total: Total return: each dividend is reinvested on its ex-date. Computed from the {source} history.
chart_total: Adjusted NAV: past prices lowered by later dividends, as if reinvested, so it ends at today's NAV.
dividends_toggle_here: When ticked, each dividend is reinvested on its ex-date, and the returns, worst fall, and chart of this fund include it. Unticked, they show the NAV change only.
compare_chart_caption_total: Growth in each fund's own currency. Funds with known dividends have them reinvested on the ex-date; the others show the NAV change.
fund_share_failed: Could not copy the link. Copy it from the address bar.
info_nav: NAV (net asset value) is the price of one unit of the fund. You buy and sell units at this price.
info_return: Return is how much the price of one unit rose or fell over the period, compared with where it started.
info_drawdown: Worst fall is the biggest drop from a high point to the lowest point after it within the period.
info_aum: Fund size (AUM) is the total money investors have put into this fund.
glance_return_up: Over the last year this fund grew {change}.
glance_return_down: Over the last year this fund fell {change}.
glance_rank_ahead: That is better than {percent} of similar funds ({type}).
glance_rank_behind: That is worse than {percent} of similar funds ({type}).
glance_drawdown: Its biggest drop in that year was {drop}.
glance_history_one: Its price history goes back 1 year.
glance_history: Its price history goes back {count} years.
cost_sources_differ: The sources give different figures and neither says as of when, so we show each one.
compare_best_note: A gold dot marks the best value in a row: the highest return, the smallest fall, the lowest expense ratio. It is not an overall ranking.
ojk_not_listed: Not in OJK's newest list; last listed in {month}
ojk_zero_notice: OJK reports zero assets for this fund in {month}: it may be dissolved, matured, or not launched yet.
benchmark_load_failed: The index failed to load. Try again.
benchmark_no_range: This index has no data at the start of this range.
api_purpose_benchmarks: The benchmark series and their latest value.
api_benchmarks_text: The series a fund page compares with: stock indices, Bareksa's fund category indices, and the BI-Rate. The data is that of data/benchmarks/ and data/macro/bi-rate.csv; the points are at {oneLink}.
api_benchmark_text: One benchmark: its metadata and every point as \{ date, value \}, oldest first. An index holds index levels (not returns, and without dividends); the BI-Rate holds percent per year on the date of each decision.
api_bm_id: The benchmark ID, for example ihsg, lq45, bareksa-equity, or bi-rate.
api_bm_name: The name in Indonesian and English: \{ id, en \}.
api_bm_description: A short description, also \{ id, en \}.
api_bm_kind: stock (a stock index), fund-category (a fund category index), or rate (an interest rate).
api_bm_source: Where we got it, for example Bareksa or Bank Indonesia.
api_bm_start_date: The date of the first value.
api_bm_end_date: The date of the last value.
api_bm_points: Every point: \{ date, value \}, oldest first.
api_funds_ojk: The name OJK uses for this fund, or null when there is no match. OJK's monthly statistics are in data/ojk/.
api_fund_ojk: What OJK says, or null when there is no match: \{ name, manager, custodian, type, currency, status, months \}. status is registered, zero_aum (zero assets in OJK's newest month), or not_listed (no longer in the newest month's list). months holds \{ month, aum, units \} per month; aum is in rupiah, also for a USD fund.
api_fund_benchmarks: The benchmarks that suit this fund's type, each \{ id, kind, end_date, value, returns \}. returns holds simplereturn, cagr, and maxdrawdown over the same periods and to the same end date as the fund; for a rate it is null and value is the rate in force. An empty list for global, USD, and other funds.
download_benchmarks_list: The benchmarks: ID, name, description, kind, and source.
download_benchmarks_csv: The daily level of one index: date and value. Price indices, without dividends.
download_macro_usdidr: The JISDOR rate (rupiah per US dollar), every business day.
download_macro_birate: The BI-Rate in percent per year, one row per monthly meeting.
download_macro_inflation: Year-on-year inflation in percent, one row per month.
download_ojk_monthly: The fund size and units of every fund OJK lists at month end, in rupiah. One file per month, the last 36 months.
